name: Lubrín (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lubrín (a lozengy field and a sword on red).
history: Lubrín was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía to adopt its municipal symbols in March 1989; the arms were adopted officially in February 2007, while the flag had to wait until September 2015 for official recognition; it is a rectangular cloth of 2:3 divided into three horizontal stripes, white at the centre and green at the edges, of widths 1/6, 4/6 and 1/6.

features.role: Lubrín arms — lozengy and sword on red
